title: Satellite images reveal Israel expanding Gaza military sites — Al Jazeera (Planet/Sentinel)
snippet: Al Jazeera Digital Investigations Unit examination of Planet Labs and Sentinel Hub satellite imagery reveals Israeli military fortifications expanding at relentless pace across Gaza, particularly in Rafah. In central Gaza, Sentinel imagery from March 15 showed ongoing trench and dirt berm reaching Maghazi camp. In Juhor ad-Dik, new roads link established military sites to newly levelled areas. 48 Israeli military sites identified by Forensic Architecture, 13 built after October ceasefire.
